messages:
elaine: quick check — proposing a soft-handoff rollout for eu-west that prioritizes tenant whitelisting + incremental ab splits. thinking: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% over 48h with warm caches and KV prefill. thoughts?

josh: sounds reasonable. need to lock telemetry gates tho: p95 latency <120ms, error rate <0.5%, quality regression <1% on our eval set.

mona: agree on gates. add cost gate: CPU/GPU token cost > baseline+40% => pause. also request per-tenant token quota to avoid noisy neighbors.

alex: technical note — for the EU private deployments we should use the quantized fallback variant (q4_1) on canary overflow. plan: primary model v2 (fp16), fallback v2-q (int4) via routing policy.

sam: small ask: add a warmup job to prefill prefix KV for the top 100 tenants to avoid cold kv spikes. script runs as a job that hits /prefill with sample prompts. can share script.

elaine: yes please add the prefill. @devops-bot can we schedule the job during the 2:00–4:00 UTC window?

devops-bot: scheduled: prefill-job -> eu-west -> 2026-04-02T02:15:00Z. reminder + notify in #incidents if any node crosses 85% GPU util.

rebecka: rollout cadence proposal: 12h observation at 0.5% (smoke), 24h at 2% (stability), 48h ramp to 10% (scale). each step requires green on gates and no manual kill requests.

josh: add AB variant for prompt-tuning: 50/50 split in the 10% cohort to validate quality and cost delta. metric: completion perplexity + human-sample pass rate.

mona: edge-case: if eu capacity constrained, fallback plan is to route to dedicated-us-east pool + compress payloads + enforce tenant rate limits. that should keep SLAs and avoid wide outage.

alex: implementation detail for feature flags: flag = feature.rollout.eu_soft_handoff. config JSON example:
```
{
  "stages": [
    {"pct": 0.5, "duration": "12h", "whitelist": ["tenant:beta-*"]},
    {"pct": 2, "duration": "24h"},
    {"pct": 10, "duration": "48h"}
  ],
  "gates": {"p95_latency_ms": 120, "err_rate_pct": 0.5, "cost_delta_pct": 40}
}
```

sam: perfect. also include a canary manual-override endpoint and a single-click kill-switch that flips routing to stable variant only. ops needs that button in Console.

elaine: decode responsibility: product owns rollout plan + gates, eng owns automation and fallback wiring, devops owns prefill and monitoring. I'll draft the Launch Checklist and share tomorrow. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: test matrix queued: integration, perf(50k tokens), ab-eval on sample prompts. ETA results ~ 6h.

josh: last ask — notify the top 10 customers in the 10% step with a heads-up and opt-out link. legal/compliance ok?

mona: compliance ok for eu tenants, make sure audit logs capture model version and routing decisions.

elaine: cool — I'll send the checklist + customer note by EOD. if no objections, we ship the plan to run next week. :rocket:
